name: com.aimlrounds/aimlrounds
title: AIML Rounds
description: Free AI/ML interview prep: lessons, system design, quizzes, mock interviews and AI/ML jobs in India.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search AIML Rounds lessons by keywords or an interview question. Filter by track (fundamentals, ai-engineering, system-design, papers), type (concept, interview, design, paper) or section/part name. Returns lesson ids for get_lesson.

query.description: Keywords or a question, e.g. 'KV cache', 'why does RAG retrieve the wrong chunk'

track.description: Limit to one track: fundamentals, ai-engineering, system-design or papers

type.description: concept = lesson, interview = scenario set, design = system design question, paper = paper explained

section.description: Part or section name to filter by, e.g. 'RAG', 'LLMs', 'Recommendation Systems'

limit.description: How many lessons to return (1–30, default 8)

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Browse the site's table of contents. No arguments: the 4 tracks with their parts and sections. With track: every section and lesson in it (optionally narrowed by part).

track.description: Limit to one track: fundamentals, ai-engineering, system-design or papers

part.description: Part name within the track, e.g. 'Maths for ML', 'RAG', 'Agentic AI'

tools.name: get_lesson
tools.description: Read one lesson as Markdown: the interview situation, intuition, how it works (with equations in TeX), in practice, and the model interview answer with follow-ups. Use an id from search (e.g. 'ai-engineering/prefill-vs-decode'), a page URL or a title. Use tab to read one part only.

tab.description: Optional: only this part, e.g. 'Intuition', 'How it works' / 'Maths', 'In practice', 'Say it' (the interview answer)

tools.name: roadmap
tools.description: The study roadmap for a role (AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist): topics in order, core vs useful, each with its lessons and quiz. No role: list the roles.

with_lessons.description: Include lesson titles and ids for each topic

tools.name: quiz
tools.description: Multiple-choice questions for a roadmap topic (e.g. 'Linear algebra', 'RAG', 'Inference and serving'). Answers stay hidden unless reveal_answers is true: ask the learner first, then call again with reveal_answers to grade and explain. No topic: list topics.

reveal_answers.description: Include the correct option and its explanation. Keep false while the learner is answering; set true to grade.

tools.name: mock_interview
tools.description: Mock interview rounds per role, with model answers and what the interviewer listens for. No round: list the role's rounds. Keep include_answers false while the learner is answering; set it true to give feedback.

include_answers.description: Include model answers and what the interviewer listens for. Keep false during the mock; set true to give feedback.

tools.name: jobs
tools.description: AI/ML job postings in India from the last 7 days (100+ companies, refreshed daily), newest first, with direct apply links to the company's careers page. Most jobs include skills and key requirement lines from the job description, useful for matching against a resume. Filter by keywords (title or skill), company, city or years of experience.

query.description: Words in the job title or a skill, e.g. 'machine learning engineer', 'GenAI', 'PyTorch'

company.description: Company name or part of it, e.g. 'Walmart', 'Google'

location.description: City, e.g. 'Bengaluru', 'Hyderabad', 'Remote'. Old names like 'Bangalore' or 'Gurgaon' also work

limit.description: How many jobs to return (1–100, default 20)

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Lessons, designs, quizzes and mock rounds added to the site recently, newest first.

limit.description: How many recent items to return (1–60, default 15)
